qa_method: Independent re-solve from stem+choices before comparing proposed answer; then classical auxiliary meaning, connection, explanation, distractor, ID, answer-position, exact-duplicate, and high-similarity review.
ambiguity_review: Before merge, standalone completion-ぬ examples that could also parse morphologically as negative ず were replaced with forms distinguishable from negative ず; 0291, 0294, and 0296 were rechecked after replacement.
content_review: Confirmed completion where an action/change reaches a completed state, and emphasis where つ/ぬ combines with む or べし (てむ・なむ・つべし・ぬべし). All 25 stems had one defensible answer from stem+choices alone.
release_rule: These IDs passed independent content QA but still require the future revision-bound global semantic near-duplicate gate before production-bank approval.
